repairs.cause: The search for 'Malbun' returned no hits because the query is limited to a 20-mile radius around the current map position, and Malbun (Liechtenstein) lies outside it; the screen itself offers "INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS" as the remedy.

The search UI was never actually opened — the "Type to search all" field was never found, so the text was typed into wrong elements and no search results ever appeared (hence "INCREASE SEARCH RADIUS" was never found). No marker was ever created, and the final a11y tree shows only the status bar and the bare map, with no usable controls to continue from.

The agent never actually opened OsmAnd's search UI — it stayed on MapActivity the whole time, typing "Nendeln, Liechtenstein" into non-editable elements (index 2 is the status-bar clock) and pressing enter on the map, so no search result was ever opened and no marker was ever added; the oracle found no marker for Nendeln.

The agent never actually opened OsmAnd's search UI — its taps and typed text went to map-screen widgets, so no search result or "Add marker" action was ever reached; it ended with the notification shade pulled down and no marker created.
